name: easee-test-node-red-5
description: Installs node-red 5 for `pnpm test:node-red-5` (EASEE-41). A pnpm workspace package rather than an npm-alias devDependency on the root, because pnpm audit keys its request tree by package name and an alias of node-red beside node-red drops one line's whole subtree from the audit (EASEE-48).
